brief:
Gaza's Interior Ministry confirmed that Brigadier General Naeem Abu Mohammed Nahel, 50, who headed Hamas's internal security apparatus, was killed in an Israeli strike, according to Middle East Eye. Nahel oversaw the militant group's internal security operations in the territory at the time of his death.

The killing removes a senior commander from Hamas's security hierarchy during the organization's ongoing confrontation with Israeli military operations in Gaza.
dek: Gaza confirms death of Hamas internal security chief after Israeli strike Gaza’s Interior Ministry says Brigadier General Naeem Abu Mohammed Nahel, 50, who headed Hamas’s internal security apparatus in the territory, has been killed in an Israeli strike.
title: Israeli strike kills Hamas internal security chief in Gaza
